Maya (sales-eng): Heads up — ACME POC blocked on user/group provisioning. They have a multi‑IDP setup (Okta + Azure AD) and just rotated the SAML certs. SCIM calls are returning 403 after the rotation, blocking the final sync.
Sam (solutions): Can you paste the SCIM error and any SAML assertion/log snippets? Do we have the SP metadata they uploaded?
Maya (sales-eng): Logs from their retries: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Groups 403 Forbidden
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error"], "detail":"SCIM provisioning disabled for tenant due to assertion mismatch"}
```
Also seeing SAML validation failures: relaystate mismatch + signature verification failed after cert rotate.
Ben (security): 403 usually means either the SCIM token is invalid/expired or the request is coming from an unexpected origin. If cert rotated, the SAML assertion might not map to the tenant yet. :thinking_face:
Maya (sales-eng): They provision via customer-managed SCIM creds (not Hosted API). They rotated the cert yesterday and said they updated metadata, but sync still fails. They need group sync (1k users) before EOD for the demo.
Priya (ops): If they've rotated certs, the SP metadata in our SSO gateway must contain the new cert or we need to accept the previous cert for a grace period. For POCs we can enable a short dual-cert acceptance window and temporary SCIM override. Ops + security signoff required.
Sam (solutions): Proposal: create a short-lived Hosted API key with scim:write scope tied to the tenant so they can finish provisioning while they fix their IDP. That avoids touching the Dedicated pool or VPC config. Would that be acceptable?
Ben (security): Acceptable if we enforce: 1) TTL = 4 hours, 2) explicit audit annotation, 3) revoke immediately if misuse. Also require customer proof that both certs are uploaded and we verify fingerprints.
Priya (ops): I can provision the temp key and enable a 24h dual-cert window for the tenant on the sso-proxy. I'll add an audit ticket and tag the key "poc-temp-scim-key".
Sam (solutions): I'll send the customer a step-by-step to use the temp key for SCIM POSTs and request them to re-upload IDP metadata for both IDPs. Include this snippet for headers:
```
Authorization: Bearer <poc-temp-scim-key>
Content-Type: application/scim+json
X-ACME-Tenant: acme-poc
```
Maya (sales-eng): Customer asked whether this impacts Dedicated pool access / latency SLA if they decide to switch. Also asked for a short pricing note for a Dedicated trial. I'll follow up on pricing separately.
Priya (ops): Done — temp key created and DM'ed to sales via secure channel. Dual-cert window enabled until 1999506160 (epoch). Audit ticket INC-2026 created with required approvals.
OpsBot: Deploy: applied config change to sso-proxy for tenant acme-poc at 1999504500.
Maya (sales-eng): Customer retried and reports SCIM sync succeeded. Thanks all. I'll confirm after they finish full user import. :pray:
Sam (solutions): Follow-up items: 1) Sam to send runbook + temp-key expiration reminder to customer. 2) Priya to remove dual-cert window after expiry. 3) Ben to confirm audit log. 4) Maya to collect Dedicated trial interest & usage numbers.
Maya (sales-eng): Closing loop — SCIM groups synced, demo remains on schedule. Will reopen if anything else pops up.
